rationale: We eliminate the -$9,500 to -$17,400 deficit against champions by extending land expansion from 24 plots at Day 13 to 28-32 plots frozen at Day 16 across 10-11 hands, fully utilizing labor capacity to capture 4 late-game Strawberry harvest flushes. We eradicate field travel thrashing by coupling shed drop-offs with immediate central well refills so hands return to plots with 100% full watering cans for seamless in-situ harvest-and-watering. Finally, we defend high crop margins by restoring a >= 0.82x floor on mature compounding days (Day 17-28), capping liquidation orders at <= 3 slots per step to respect the 10-order engine cap, and unlocking town shop arbitrage via rapid <= 4-day crops (max 2-3 plots) while strictly barring slow 6+ day crops that cannibalize recurring Strawberry compounding.
